primary_hypothesis: Official masks yield unusually fewer retained nonpeer edges at N300 than independent uniform masks with identical per-row clue counts, conditional on the six fixed complete-board banks.
primary_statistic: Sum of extra-edge counts across the six banks at N300. Lower is more efficient constraint coverage.
primary_test: 1024 joint Monte Carlo draws, one-sided p=(1+number(simulated statistic <= official statistic))/1025. Reject uniform-mask null in the stated direction iff p<=.01. Otherwise the proposed unusually-few-extra-edges effect is not supported; failure to reject is not equivalence.
mask_rng: NumPy2.3.4 default_rng(20261120+bank_seed), sequential draw0..1023. Each draw rng.permuted(broadcast arange81 to(3000,81).copy(),axis=1) gives independent row permutations; given=permutation<original_row_clue_count. All prefixes nested within each draw.
first_stream: Draw0 in every bank is prespecified for inference before randomization outcomes. Never choose a stream based on extra edges or accuracy.
estimator: Never-equal jointly-observed counts, no Sudoku geometry. Retain masks and source arrays for draw0, per-draw support-byte hashes and prefix extra-edge counts for all1024 streams. All true peers must remain present.
expectation: Conditional expected extras=sum over nonpeer pairs product over rows with equal values of(1-k_t(k_t-1)/(81*80)). Independently evaluate by row-wise multiplication and summed log factors; compare Monte Carlo means with exact expectations descriptively for every bank and prefix. No pair-independence assumption.
secondary: N1000/N3000 recovery and per-bank effects descriptive. One fixed uniform-mask versus official-mask N300 search per bank on fresh test rows, report paired two-way bootstrap95percent interval descriptively,5000draws,RNG20261121.
search: Unit1 equal-digit repulsion,B0,tau0,ebar0,temp.4->.31,focus.45,C4,check4096,anneal524288,cap262144,seed=bank_seed,tol.001. No prepare/solution_stats on hidden completions.
budget: 30 GPU-minutes maximum envelope. No duplicate inference for byte-identical model/settings/seed. CPU counting or exact CPU-validated GPU counting may be used; optimize actual runtime, not utilization.
validation: Preserve source rows, solution arrays and original clue counts. Save models before geometry audit. Missing-value substitutions invariant. Independent recount plus sparse/general and hidden-target trajectory parity. Audit all returned boards.
limitations: Conditional randomization changes masks only; it is not uniform Sudoku generation.
Uniform masks can produce non-unique puzzles; these masks are only training observations. Official test puzzles remain unchanged.
Official masks can encode puzzle-generator selection. A significant coverage effect does not identify which generator mechanism caused it.
BP AdamW is outside this mask-count mechanism study and is not run.
